questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Women ______ their male relatives to the battlefield for the purpose of tending the wounded and carrying away the dead.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4 i.e. (accompany)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct verb to use in this context is "accompany", which means going somewhere with (someone) as a companion or escort.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read, "Women accompany their male relatives to the battlefield for the purpose of tending the wounded and carrying away the dead."
 
• This makes Option 4 (accompany) the correct choice to fill the blank.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: "Women accompany their male relatives to the battlefield for the purpose of tending the wounded and carrying away the dead."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Signify" - This is a verb that means to be an indication of.
 
• "Forsake" - This is a verb that means abandon or leave.
 
• "Justify" - This is a verb that means to prove to be right or reasonable.

• The most appropriate word for the given blank is **'restrictions'.**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The tone of his voice seemed to ______ that he knew more than he was letting on.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **imply.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"imply"** means to suggest or indicate something indirectly. (संकेत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **His tone seemed to imply that he was unhappy with the decision.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word "imply" fits best in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incise** (काटना): To cut into a surface.

 
 
• **Example:** The surgeon had to incise the tissue to reach the affected area.
 
 
 
• **Intent** (इरादा): A purpose or intention.
 
 
• **Example:** His intent was clear when he started the project.
 
 
 
• **Inculcate** (सिखाना): To instill an idea or habit by persistent instruction.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher aimed to inculcate good study habits in her students.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher asked us to _______ our homework by tomorrow.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**complete**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**complete**" means to finish making or doing.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the teacher is instructing students to finish their homework by tomorrow.
 
• The other options: "**completing**," "**completed**," and "**completes**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The teacher asked us to complete__ our homework by tomorrow.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Completing**: Present participle form; not suitable for this context.
 
• **Completed**: Past participle form; not suitable for this context.
 
• **Completes**: Third person singular present form; not suitable for this context.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Modern technology has created many new jobs that require ______ skills and knowledge.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'specialised.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about the requirement of skills and knowledge in the jobs created by modern technology.
 
• The use of the word 'knowledge' in the sentence indicates **facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is '**specialised**'.
 
• The word 'specialised' means **having or needing deep or special knowledge of a particular subject**. 
 
 
• Example:* Unlike snakes, lizards have not **specialised** in chemical warfare*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete Sentence: *Modern technology has created many new jobs that require specialised skills and knowledge*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Hard' means **difficult to do or understand; not easy**. (जिसे करना या समझना कठिन हो, दुष्‍कर और दुर्बोध; कठिन)
 
• '**Dangerous**' means **likely to cause injury or damage**. (ख़तरनाक, भयंकर)
 
• 'Common' means **happening or found often or in many places; usual**. (सामान्‍य, आम)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **आधुनिक तकनीक द्वारा सृजित नौकरियों में कौशल और ज्ञान की आवश्यकता के बारे में** बात कर रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में 'knowledge' शब्द का प्रयोग **अनुभव या शिक्षा के माध्यम से प्राप्त तथ्यों, सूचनाओं और कौशल** को इंगित करता है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'specialised' है।
 
• 'Specialised' शब्द का अर्थ है **किसी क्षेत्र-विशेष में विशेषज्ञता प्राप्‍त**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *Unlike snakes, lizards have not specialised in chemical warfare*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *Modern technology has created many new jobs that require specialised skills and knowledge*.

The life of the church seems, indeed, to have been in a more stagnant and ______ condition in this age than at any other period of English history.
questions.solution:
Here, the correct answer is "torpid."

__
 
• The word "torpid" would fit in the blank.
 
• **"Torpid"** refers to a state of inactivity, sluggishness, or lethargy. (निष्क्रियता, सुस्ती या सुस्ती की स्थिति)
 
 
• **Example**:* The **torpid**__ cat lazily stretched out in the sun, showing no interest in the activities around it.*
 
 
 
• It describes something that is dormant, slow-moving, or lacking in energy and vitality.
 
• In a broader sense, it can be used to characterize a lack of responsiveness or a dull, unenergetic condition.
 
• Here,** "torpid" **suggests a state of inactivity, sluggishness, or stagnation in describing the condition of the church.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

Correct sentence*: The life of the church seems, indeed, to have been in a more stagnant and __**torpid**__ condition in this age than at any other period of English history.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We are planning to see an ____________ perform a symphony.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Orchestra)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Orchestra"** refers to a large group of musicians who play various musical instruments together, often led by a conductor, especially for classical music performances. (वाद्यवृंद)

 
 
• **Example:** The orchestra performed a beautiful rendition of Beethoven's symphony.
 
 
 
• The word **"Opera"** refers to a dramatic work combining text (libretto) and musical score, often performed in a theatrical setting, with singers and musicians. (संगीत नाटक)
 
 
• **Example:** The opera singer captivated the audience with her powerful voice.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence, seeing an orchestra perform a symphony is the most appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Orchestra)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Opera** (संगीत नाटक): A theatrical performance that combines music and drama, typically with singers and an orchestra.

 
 
• **Example:** She went to see an opera at the grand theater.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Actor** (अभिनेता): A person who performs roles in plays, movies, or television shows.
 
 
• **Example:** The actor delivered a stunning performance in the movie.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Actress** (अभिनेत्री): A female performer who acts in plays, movies, or television shows.
 
 
• **Example:** The actress won an award for her brilliant portrayal of the character.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Cultural heritage is the lifeblood of any _______ and serves as a link between generations.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**civilisation**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**civilisation**" refers to the stage of human social development and organization that is considered advanced. It is the most fitting word in the context of cultural heritage being essential for societal progress.
 
• Cultural heritage is indeed a key element for any society or civilisation as it preserves traditions, customs, and collective memory across generations.
 
• The other options: "**lethargy**," "**birthright**," and "**believe**" do not fit as appropriately as "civilisation." "Lethargy" means sluggishness, "birthright" refers to an inherited right, and "believe" is an abstract verb that does not match the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Cultural heritage is the lifeblood of any civilisation__ and serves as a link between generations.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lethargy (आलस्य)**: Refers to a state of sluggishness or lack of energy, which is not relevant to the context of cultural heritage.
 
• **Birthright (जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार)**: Refers to an inherited right, which doesn’t fit the context of culture and heritage being central to a society's development.
 
• **Believe (विश्वास)**: This is a verb and doesn’t fit grammatically or contextually with the sentence describing cultural heritage.
